objective: Complete BUKLOD System Admin backend capacity bars and sustained warning push, prepare for consolidated OTA without publishing.

chosenApproach: Guard read-only JSON RPC behind database is_system_admin(); private low-frequency hourly snapshot with 60-day retention; isolated Expo Router AdminGate screen linked from first-open Reports drawer. Show only measured values and explicitly null provider utilization, and retain manual provider links. Use server-authorized Supabase Metrics API for real RAM/filesystem and CPU load per core, not misidentified as CPU utilization. Chain push alert detection after existing hourly sampler.
selectionRationale: Avoid false capacity percentages, added third-party monitoring cost or altering current video/ads. No secrets in client and only one small hourly database sample. Built-in infrastructure metrics and existing push minimize cost and duplicate monitoring infrastructure.
alternativeApproaches: Call Supabase management API from client, rejected because it exposes private provider keys and privileged metrics.
Show CPU/RAM estimates derived from PostgreSQL connections, rejected because they are not real compute utilization.
Buy larger Supabase compute now, rejected without sustained capacity evidence.
Paid third-party observability, rejected while Supabase built-in metrics are sufficient.
